verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh lets an agent run its screening pipeline through the API. It can create and screen customers synchronously or asynchronously, get outcomes via `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhooks or result endpoints, review cases and alerts via the API, look customers up by external identifier, and set ongoing monitoring per customer. API credentials have configurable permissions and expiry dates. However, the pipeline is AML/sanctions screening rather than identity-verification sessions with document data extraction, there is no MCP surface, and no explicit on-demand re-check endpoint is documented. Missing for 10: IDV session creation and extracted-data retrieval, an explicit re-check/rescreen trigger, an MCP server, and hands-on authenticated corroboration.
